title: Partition the look-dev capture matrix to fit its CTest timeout
body: The full queued look-dev CTest matrix timed out at 1200.11 seconds before implementation. Recovery selected each state with VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_STATE and ran the same four-angle, byte-repeat capture check in four passing state-scoped invocations. Suggested consolidation: register per-state CTest cases or provide a supported timeout policy so the required matrix can complete without exceeding the fixed job limit.

title: Add a reusable dependency-free PNG metric tool for visual witnesses
body: To report the visual bible gates, I had to write an inline standard-library PNG decoder and encoder to calculate Rec.709 luminance quantiles, HSV emissive area, and contact sheets. Pillow and NumPy were unavailable and no ImageMagick or ffmpeg executable was installed. Suggested consolidation: add a maintained capture tool that computes these metrics and lays out before, after, and reference images without undeclared Python packages.

title: Select the worktree FetchContent cache without an explicit environment override
body: The fresh queued configure required manually setting VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE to this worktree local cache path before running cmake --preset vixen-wsl. The configure succeeded, but the cache selection is an extra per lane environment override. Suggested consolidation: have the documented configure path select the shared or worktree FetchContent cache automatically and record the chosen location.

title: Use the VIXEN preset binary directory for queued rebuild witnesses
body: The generic queued cmake --build build invocation failed with could not load cache because this VIXEN preset stores CMakeCache.txt at build/wsl, as declared by VIXEN/CMakePresets.json. Recovery is to run the same queued no-op build at cmake --build build/wsl. Suggested consolidation: make the shared VIXEN build witness resolve the active preset binaryDir instead of assuming build/.

title: Route VIXEN GPU capture CTests through exclusive queue admission
body: The documented CTest invocation used the global queue resource test, while its vixen_lock_gpu_tests lock only covers one build tree. Two final night capture attempts were killed by the idle-stall guard at 456 seconds and 213 seconds while other worktrees ran VIXEN rendering tasks. The same CTest passed through the supported global queue resource gpu with --exclusive, and all four final state-scoped runs passed there. Suggested consolidation: route VIXEN rendering CTests through exclusive GPU queue admission in the lane guidance and witness examples.
